title: Fix the missing Historical Gross/Net parity venue revision Details argument
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text:
Во время билда вылезла вот такая ошибка:

There is no argument given that corresponds to the required parameter 'Details' of 'HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult.HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult(bool, bool, HistoricalGrossNetParityOwnership, decimal?, decimal?, decimal?, bool, string)'

Исправь, пожалуйста

scope.goal: Eliminate the reported missing-Details compiler error in the successful Historical Gross/Net parity VenueReported revision result construction.
inScope: Build and focused test verification of that constructor-call correction.
outOfScope: Changing the HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult record signature or any accounting, ownership, balance, database, service, trading, or runtime behavior.
Changing any other constructor call, product file, test behavior, documentation, or unrelated compiler error.
scope.periodOrFilter: not-applicable; this is a compile-time constructor-call correction with no data or time window
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the record declaration and every HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult construction, and confirm which exact call omits the required Details argument.

requirements.text: Supply the required Details argument on the successful HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult return while preserving its existing seven result values and all runtime accounting behavior.
requirements.sourceQuote: There is no argument given that corresponds to the required parameter 'Details'
acceptanceCriteria: The successful return supplies the exact non-empty Details text VenueReported evidence revision applied.
The existing Applied, Idempotent, Ownership, RequestedDelta, ActualAppliedDelta, ResidualUnappliedDelta, and BalanceDeferred arguments remain unchanged, and the record declaration remains unchanged.
The reported CS7036/missing-Details compiler failure is absent from the solution build; the focused Historical Gross/Net parity Live-flow tests pass.
No product or test file other than src/PolyCopyTrader.Storage/PostgresAppRepository.HistoricalGrossNetParity.cs is changed by this correction.

verification.command: Inspect every HistoricalGrossNetParityVenueRevisionResult construction with rg and inspect the focused diff.
verification.expected: Every construction supplies all eight parameters and the focused diff changes only the successful return's Details argument.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln -c Debug --artifacts-path <marked D:\CodexTemp run artifacts path>
verification.expected: Build exits 0 without the reported missing-Details compiler error; warnings are reported exactly.

verification.command: dotnet test tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests.csproj -c Debug --no-restore --filter FullyQualifiedName~HistoricalGrossNetParityLiveFlowTests --artifacts-path <marked D:\CodexTemp run artifacts path> --results-directory <marked D:\CodexTemp run results path>
verification.expected: Focused Historical Gross/Net parity Live-flow tests exit 0 with no failures.
